title: Niagara Falls & Niagara on the Lake Luxury SUV VIP Private Tour
blurb:
Your VIP Niagara Falls Getaway – Luxury, Your Way

Looking for the ultimate way to explore Niagara Falls? Our VIP Private Tour is the perfect mix of comfort, style, and total flexibility—designed just for you and your group of four or more.

Hop into a luxury SUV with your own professional chauffeur and kick back as we take care of everything. From hotel pick-up to the final drop-off, your day is completely built around what you want to do.

Want to sip wine at a gorgeous vineyard? Take a boat ride right up to the Falls? Stroll through the charming streets of Niagara-on-the-Lake? Done. You choose the vibe—we make it happen.

The best part? You set the pace. Spend more time where you want, skip what you don’t, and enjoy the freedom of having the whole day tailored just for you. Your guide is there when you need them, and gives you space when you want it.

* Let TOCA Concierge team book your Excursions and Wine tastings can be booked at additional cost
